# Collect secure-mail telemetry after cryptographic processing completes

At the accepted endpoint, msgHdrView records S/MIME telemetry from smimeprocessed and OpenPGP telemetry from openpgpprocessed, then dispatches SecureMailLoaded. The current test arms the corresponding loaded event before selecting a row and asserts one event for each expected security-status combination. This later endpoint differs from the landing-era repeated-selection assertion; it does not by itself validate every reload or duplicate-event path. These are fixed accepted source and test-code observations. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint, live accessibility or crypto/TLS validation ran.

Scope: mail/base/content.
